answer_text:
We are given

\[
f(x+1)=\frac12+\sqrt{f(x)-[f(x)]^2}
\]

for all real \(x\), and

\[
f(-1)=\frac12.
\]

Let

\[
T(a)=\frac12+\sqrt{a-a^2}.
\]

Then the recurrence is simply

\[
f(x+1)=T(f(x)).
\]

Now compute the next few values:

\[
f(0)=T\left(\frac12\right)
=\frac12+\sqrt{\frac12-\frac14}
=\frac12+\sqrt{\frac14}
=\frac12+\frac12=1.
\]

Then

\[
f(1)=T(1)
=\frac12+\sqrt{1-1}
=\frac12.
\]

Thus

\[
f(-1)=\frac12,\qquad f(0)=1,\qquad f(1)=\frac12.
\]

So for integer inputs, the values alternate:

\[
f(n)=
\begin{cases}
1, & n \text{ even},\\
\frac12, & n \text{ odd}.
\end{cases}
\]

Since \(2007\) is odd,

\[
f(2007)=\frac12.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac12}
\]
